Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and mild proteinuria are present. Glucosuria is noted without ketonuria, which may warrant further evaluation for glycemic status. Low specific gravity suggests dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
